mapper.sql: b.id, b.user_id, b.book_id, b.borrow_time, b.return_time, u.name as user_name, k.book_name as book_name
mapper.select: select from borrow b left join `user` u on u.id = b.user_id left join book k on k.id = b.book_id order by b.id desc
select from borrow b left join `user` u on u.id = b.user_id left join book k on k.id = b.book_id where b.user_id = #{userId} order by b.id desc
select from borrow b left join `user` u on u.id = b.user_id left join book k on k.id = b.book_id where b.id = #{id}
select count(*) from borrow where user_id = #{userId}
select count(*) from borrow where book_id = #{bookId}
mapper.insert: insert into borrow (user_id, book_id, borrow_time, return_time) values (#{userId}, #{bookId}, #{borrowTime}, #{returnTime})
